snippet.title: [VR GAME] Forbidden Art Main Teaser
snippet.description:
🔹 Title: Forbidden Art
🔹 Game/Experience: VR horror escape room puzzle game
🔹 Release Date: 25 March 2024

🎮 Welcome to AIXLAB GAMES! 🎮
Forbidden Art is a VR escape room puzzle horror game where you must escape from a killer’s secret lair.
You start locked in a prison-like dungeon and make your way through secret passages, studies, morgues, vents, a chapel, and more, trying to escape the underground hideout without being seen by the killer.

⚙️ Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1166140

👍 Like · Comment · Subscribe to stay updated!
